context: Request: every fund the firm has formed that carries both a key-person provision and a GP clawback, with the LPA/side documents. Rubric: 1001-00002 (Ardent; carried-interest-allocation-agreement.docx and lpa-amendment-no-1.docx), 1003-00002 (Harrowgate), 1024-00002 (Driftwood), 1027-00002 (Pellegrino), proof documents for each, plus a precision criterion.

stages.note: Whole-store glob; review flags the cap.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). A folder glob plus file-name globs for request words; the folder glob and one name glob return nothing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A broad store-wide extraction script times out after about 2.2M chars; a narrower one also times out. Review: goal not reached.

stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (attempt 2). Three parallel scripts extracting matching passages from all files of seven named candidate matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide scan split into three matter-number ranges for files holding both terms; the last range prints nothing.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: same stage, continued. Opening reads of governing documents, side letters and memos of the six matters, plus two snippet scripts.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Further reads of two weighed-and-excluded candidates and more governing documents of a matter it kept.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four qualifying structures with their document lists.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Checks cited paths exist and edits the opening and completeness wording.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It found all four qualifying matters, but for one of them it never opened or cited the carry agreement that its first scan had listed as a clawback hit; it chose documents through same-document co-hit filters and never listed that matter's folder.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: The first scan's per-file output ([17]) showed the carry agreement of a matter it kept, but when it picked documents to read and extract from that matter ([41]-[42]) it left that file out, and later same-document filters dropped it as a single-term hit.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The stage review said only one document was opened per matter for some candidates, without naming the document; no later stage listed that matter's folder.

divergence: Mixed outcomes. All runs found the four qualifying matters through store-wide scans. T0 and T1 listed every file of the matters they kept (T0 [43]-[51], T1 [52]-[53]), saw the carry agreement in that listing and cited it; T2 never listed that matter's folder, chose its documents from scan hits and same-document co-hit filters, and left out the one document holding only the clawback term. The split is at the candidate-document step after the scans (T2 stage 5); the reviews there were similar in all runs (unopened surfaced matters), and none named the missing document (T2 got only a generic flag about reading one document per matter).
